svg.title: What I do
svg.desc: Backend and APIs: Python since 2016, FastAPI, Celery, PostgreSQL, Redis. REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth2, KSeF.; Custom systems and apps: Built to order: purchasing decision platform, Budibase apps, CRM and invoice workflow.; AI agents and orchestration: Multi-agent systems on Claude, OpenAI and Gemini. Test gates, cross-model review, human approval.; RAG: Structure-aware chunking, hybrid retrieval, reranking. Every answer cites its source or abstains.; Fine-tuning and evaluation: Polish embedding fine-tune, LoRA, golden datasets, A/B tests, drift detection.; Research and open source: Redcon, a benchmark on the fly visual system, papers in preparation.; Integrations and automation: n8n, ERP and CRM, monday.com, KSeF. 40+ deployments at companies of 20 to 200 people.; Infrastructure and deployment: Docker and Kubernetes on client servers or in their AWS accounts. CI/CD, backups, tracing.; Security by design: Non-root containers, least privilege, secrets management, prompt-injection defence, audit logs.
